hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.

The factors of $9$ are $1, 3,$ and $9.$

$9$ has $3$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $31$ are $1$ and $31.$

$31$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.

The factors of $39$ are $1, 3, 13$ and $39.$

$39$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $44$ are $1, 2, 4, 11, 22,$ and $44.$

$44$ has $6$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $95$ are $1, 5, 19,$ and $95.$

$95$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.
